title: Interactions between phosvitin and aldehydes affect the release of flavor from Russian sturgeon caviar.
authors: Zhang, Weijia; Liu, Li; Zhao, Yuanhui; Liu, Tianhong; Bai, Fan; Wang, Jinlin; Xu, He; Gao, Ruichang; Jiang, Xiaoming; Xu, Xinxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鱼卵磷蛋白与醛类风味物质的结合释放机制，属于蛋白质-小分子配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The release mechanism of flavor during caviar storage was studied by the interaction between phosvitin and four aldehydes. Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry showed that the binding rate of phosvitin with 3-methylbutanal, nonanal, (E,Z)-2,6-nonadienal, and (E)-2-octenal decreased with an increase in the aldehyde concentrations. Among them, (E,Z)-2,6-Nonadienal (0.5 mM) had the highest binding rate (84.47%). The main quenching mechanism of (E,Z)-2,6-nonadienal with phosvitin was static quenching and the binding force comprised spontaneous hydrophobic interactions. An increase in the aldehyde concentrations reduced the alpha-helix content of phosvitin and led to aggregation of the microstructure of phosvitin. The results of molecular docking showed that tyr residue contributed the most to the binding of phosvitin to aldehydes. This study has elucidated the mechanism of the effect of caviar protein on changes in the caviar flavor during storage and provides effective strategies for regulation of caviar flavor during storage.
abstract_zh: 通过卵黄高磷蛋白（phosvitin）与四种醛类化合物之间的相互作用，研究了鱼子酱储存期间风味的释放机制。气相色谱-质谱联用分析表明，phosvitin与3-甲基丁醛、壬醛、(E,Z)-2,6-壬二烯醛和(E)-2-辛烯醛的结合率随醛浓度的增加而降低。其中，(E,Z)-2,6-壬二烯醛（0.5 mM）的结合率最高（84.47%）。(E,Z)-2,6-壬二烯醛与phosvitin的主要猝灭机制为静态猝灭，结合力涉及自发性疏水相互作用。醛浓度的增加降低了phosvitin的α-螺旋含量，并导致phosvitin微观结构的聚集。分子对接结果表明，酪氨酸残基对phosvitin与醛类结合贡献最大。本研究阐明了鱼子酱蛋白在储存期间影响风味变化的机制，并为调控鱼子酱储存期间的风味提供了有效策略。
